name: easyeda-pro-control
description: Safety-gated EasyEDA API coverage, fixed typed SDK reads, design operations and seven engineering skills.

interface.longDescription: Seven skills cover control, schematics, PCB layout, libraries, manufacturing, design review and extensions. Per-method inventory distinguishes fixed public calls, native equivalents, blocked implementations and omissions. Sixteen bounded supplied-coordinate calculation subsets include orthogonal integer-polygon clipping with complete holes and disconnected output regions. They have a separate exact EasyEDA 3.2.206/API 0.3.50 runtime profile; connected calculation validation remains outstanding. New or unknown configured tuples expose only reference, discovery, status and calculations; missing installation files select offline-only startup. The older reviewed tuple retains guarded readers, footprint typed API operations, native controls, checkpoints and recovery. Schematic-page, symbol and PCB design transactions plus eight metadata writers remain blocked pending native structure-job completion and full SQL-effect proof. Compiled topology and affected exports remain refused for hidden annotation or Save All. PCB navigation rejects unsafe preferences without changing settings. Historical evidence is generation-specific; discovery and matching samples do not prove complete source or saved state. Arbitrary JavaScript, blind retry and unrestricted Save are refused; the legacy writer is runtime-disabled. The historical reviewed tuple is connected-read-admitted; future mismatches fail closed within each capability profile.
defaultPrompt: Validate the EasyEDA bridge without bypassing compatibility gates.
Inspect the admitted EasyEDA project with exact readers and managed evidence.
Apply the requested typed design change and verify it after saving and reopening.
